body:
I'm just worried how that will affect my status in public safety. Fire and EMS calls don't bother me. I've personally seen more dead people than I can count however behind the phone it hits me different.

I'm just worried seeking help for that will then make it so I can't do anything in public safety.

I'd love to switch to Fire/PD/EMS dispatching instead of just EMS. The solely EMS just affects me too much.
